plan.title: Add detectGitPlatform helper
plan.description: Add a `detectGitPlatform(projectPath)` function that parses `git remote get-url origin` and returns `'github' | 'gitlab' | 'bitbucket' | 'unknown'`.

plan.title: Update runCreatePR for multi-platform
plan.description: Modify `runCreatePR()` to call `detectGitPlatform`, then build platform-specific agent prompts for GitHub (MCP create_pull_request), GitLab (glab mr create), and Bitbucket (API call). Add fallback instructions for unknown platforms.

plan.title: Add Bitbucket API helper
plan.description: Add a `createBitbucketPR()` helper that uses the Bitbucket REST API v2 with a stored app password. Read credentials from environment or `.teamai/providers.json`.

plan.title: Store and expose platform info
plan.description: Add `platform` field to task metadata. Update UI to show detected platform badge in task detail panel and review panel.
